searchText: Just a note that regular/scheduled forced ice ages force software updates to software clients. I would consider this a plus in security of the protocol as I'm sure people take the opportunity to patch other software when doing these updates.

excerpts.author: mightypenguin
excerpts.content:
Just a note that regular/scheduled forced ice ages force software updates to software clients.
I would consider this a plus in security of the protocol as I'm sure people take the opportunity to patch other software when doing these updates.
